group.name: AL Hospitality Group
group.tagline: Two addresses. One standard of hospitality.
group.description: AL Hospitality Group curates a small portfolio of five-star properties across Egypt, each with its own identity, from Cairo's Nile-front classic palaces to the Red Sea's modern coastline.

homepage.heroTitle: Two hotels. Every kind of stay.
homepage.heroSubtitle: A classic Nile-front palace in Cairo, and a modern coastal resort on the Red Sea, curated under one standard of service.

hotelCards.name: Aurelia Grand Hotel
hotelCards.blurb: A gilded, Nile-front palace hotel for guests who want tradition, ceremony, and grandeur.

hotelCards.name: Marisol Bay Resort
hotelCards.blurb: A modern coastal resort for guests who want open water, clean design, and quiet mornings.

faq.question: Are Aurelia Grand Hotel and Marisol Bay Resort owned by the same company?
faq.answer: Yes, both properties are part of AL Hospitality Group, though each is run as its own distinct hotel with its own design, team, and booking system.

faq.question: Can I earn or use the same loyalty benefits at both hotels?
faq.answer: Yes, AL Circle membership is shared across both properties.

faq.question: How do I choose between the two hotels?
faq.answer: Aurelia Grand Hotel suits guests who want a classic, ceremonial city-palace experience in Cairo. Marisol Bay Resort suits guests who want a modern coastal escape on the Red Sea.
